The head is not clearly visible as the focus is on the mid-section of the coiled body. The background is dark and out of focus.

The contact points between the fingers and the snake show slight blurring and 'melting' where the skin texture of the hand merges indistinctly with the snake's scales. The grip physics look slightly unnatural, with the snake appearing to float slightly within the grasp rather than being compressed.
